tableInfo.name: 患者検査結果
tableInfo.sqlForTool: WITH CONVERT_HISTORY AS( select * from sync_convert_history a inner join sync_convert_history_dtl b on (a.seq_no=b.seq_no) where table_kind = 'EXM' ),HST_DETAIL AS( SELECT a.PATID,MIN(REG_DATE) REG_DATE,MAX(UP_DATE) UP_DATE,REG_EXAM_DATE,REG_ORDER_CLASS from PAT_EXAMIN_HST_DETAIL a INNER JOIN PAT_INDEX_INFO c on a.PATID=c.PATID and PAT_STATUS='0' GROUP BY a.PATID,REG_EXAM_DATE,REG_ORDER_CLASS ) {NoWITHIndTimePeriod} select a.PATID||','|| TO_CHAR(a.REG_DATE,'yyyy/mm/dd hh24:mi:ss') ||','|| TO_CHAR(a.REG_EXAM_DATE,'yyyy/mm/dd hh24:mi:ss') ||','||a.REG_ORDER_CLASS as KEY, a.PATID, a.PATID as FN_PAT_ID, '[]' as ORDER_LABEL_INFO, EXAM_DATE, TO_CHAR(a.REG_EXAM_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') as REG_EXAM_DATE, case a.REG_ORDER_CLASS when '0' then '1' when '1' then '2' when '2' then '0' end as REG_ORDER_CLASS, DATA_GEN_CLASS, DEL_FLG, 1 as EXAM_STATUS, '' as EXAM_SET_CD, '0' as IS_ORDER, d.UP_DATE, d.REG_DATE from PAT_EXAMIN_HST a {IndTimePeriodWhere} INNER JOIN HST_DETAIL d on a.PATID = d.PATID and a.REG_ORDER_CLASS=d.REG_ORDER_CLASS and a.REG_EXAM_DATE = d.REG_EXAM_DATE where not exists(select * from PAT_EXAMIN_HST b where a.PATID=b.PATID and a.REG_EXAM_DATE=b.REG_EXAM_DATE and a.REG_ORDER_CLASS=b.REG_ORDER_CLASS and a.REG_EXAM_DATE=b.REG_EXAM_DATE and a.UP_DATE<b.UP_DATE) and exists(select * from PAT_INDEX_INFO c where a.PATID=c.PATID and PAT_STATUS='0') {sqlForSpecifyPeriod} {sqlForExclusiveOutputted} {sqlForSync} order by a.PATID,a.REG_DATE,a.REG_EXAM_DATE,a.REG_ORDER_CLASS
tableInfo.sqlForExclusiveOutputted: and not exists( select * from CONVERT_HISTORY ch where ch.facility_cd=:facility_cd {sqlForSync} and a.patid=ch.CONVERTTS and ch.table_kind = 'EXM' and a.EXAM_DATE >= ch.start_date and a.EXAM_DATE < ch.end_date + 1)

child.sqlForTool: WITH MST_EXAM_ITEM_SUB AS ( SELECT p.DATA_TYPE,p.UNIT,p.NORMAL_VALUE_UPPER,p.NORMAL_VALUE_LOWER,p.EXAM_ITEM_CD,p.REG_DATE,n.DISP_FLG FROM MST_EXAM_ITEM p INNER JOIN MST_EXAM_ITEM_SUB_NEW n ON ( p.EXAM_ITEM_CD = n.EXAM_ITEM_CD AND p.REG_DATE = n.REG_DATE) AND SERIES_CD='{SERIES_CD}' ) select a.PATID||','||TO_CHAR(a.REG_DATE,'yyyy/mm/dd hh24:mi:ss')||','||TO_CHAR(a.REG_EXAM_DATE,'yyyy/mm/dd hh24:mi:ss')||','||a.REG_ORDER_CLASS as KEY, a.REG_EXAM_DATE, a.EXAM_ITEM_CODE, a.EXAM_ITEM_NAME, a.EXAM_RST, a.EXAM_CLASS_RST, a.COMMENTS, m.DATA_TYPE, m.UNIT, m.NORMAL_VALUE_UPPER, m.NORMAL_VALUE_LOWER, eh.EXAM_DATE, row_number() over ( partition by a.PATID,a.REG_DATE,a.REG_EXAM_DATE,a.REG_ORDER_CLASS order by a.PATID,a.REG_DATE,a.REG_EXAM_DATE,a.REG_ORDER_CLASS,a.EXAM_ITEM_CODE) as DISP_ORDER from PAT_EXAMIN_HST_DETAIL a inner join PAT_EXAMIN_HST eh on( a.PATID=eh.PATID and a.REG_DATE=eh.REG_DATE and a.REG_EXAM_DATE=eh.REG_EXAM_DATE and a.REG_ORDER_CLASS=eh.REG_ORDER_CLASS) left outer join MST_EXAM_ITEM_SUB m on(a.EXAM_ITEM_CODE=m.EXAM_ITEM_CD) where not exists(select * from PAT_EXAMIN_HST_DETAIL b where a.PATID=b.PATID and a.REG_DATE=b.REG_DATE and a.REG_EXAM_DATE=b.REG_EXAM_DATE and a.REG_ORDER_CLASS=b.REG_ORDER_CLASS and a.EXAM_ITEM_CODE=b.EXAM_ITEM_CODE and a.UP_DATE<b.UP_DATE) and exists(select * from PAT_INDEX_INFO c where a.PATID=c.PATID and PAT_STATUS='0') {sqlForSpecifyPeriod} {sqlForExclusiveOutputted} {sqlForSync} order by a.PATID,a.REG_DATE,a.REG_EXAM_DATE,a.REG_ORDER_CLASS,a.EXAM_ITEM_CODE
